visual_identity.silhouette: tall, straight posture, side-parted hair, long coat
visual_identity.wardrobe: dark long coat, white shirt collar, messenger bag strap
recurring_details: left hand often holding umbrella handle

continuity_notes: Glasses must remain round and readable in close shots.
Coat length should fall below the knees.

dramatic_profile.external_goal: Determine whether the bell has a physical cause before Mira enters danger.
dramatic_profile.internal_need: Accept that care for Mira sometimes requires acting before certainty is available.
dramatic_profile.core_fear: That skepticism will become an excuse for failing to protect someone.
dramatic_profile.stakes: If he dismisses the event, Mira may face the tunnel threat alone.
dramatic_profile.flaw: He delays emotional decisions by asking increasingly precise questions.
dramatic_profile.contradiction: His cautious language accompanies the immediate choice to remain beside Mira.
moral_limits: He will not abandon Mira to investigate alone.
dramatic_profile.arc_direction: Move from detached verification toward deliberate shared risk.
relationship_drivers: Challenges Mira's assumptions without mocking her
Uses observation as a form of care
